description: TurboKain repo scaffolded: Kain-native signal tooling as the alien half of Objective 1. Source crates live in kain/ (renamed from src/ for a clean crates-like layout — every folder is its own crate with its own build.txt). markscript/ holds the campaign runtime, reports/ holds receipts, _tmp/ is scratch. No Python in the hot path, no Bazel in this repo.

Example 01: lane_sieve.kn — per-lane quarantine sieve over quantized voltage codes (LCG fill, RMS + diversity laws, spec-vs-AVX2 converge, self-validating main). Built via the installed compiler, 413 KB exe. Receipt: lanes 3 (rms+diversity) and 7 (rms) QUARANTINE, exit 0. This is the mold every TurboKain exe follows.

Example 02: cadence_pair.kn — ON/OFF cadence gate as compiler-owned semantics (authority/mirror worlds, entangle, resonate tripwires, pulse epochs, law gates). Receipt PASS; exit 0/1/2 with a telemetry guard naming which layer failed to engage.
Copied Objective 1 (the bystander mission: traffic / monuments / payloads) into the repo so every task has a north star. AGENTS.md points at it as the first read.

Wrote docs/spec.md — the TurboKain spec: what it is, why not just SetiYeti, the Kain->exe->receipts flow, open-game semantics, and the six rules (prove before replace, thresholds are data, receipts, human veto, build-is-the-gate, no hardcoded paths).

Vendored the Kain learning corpus into docs/kain/ so agents learn the language without ever entering the compiler repo: KAIN_BY_EXAMPLE.md, training/kain_omni.kn, examples/{fusion_chain,keyword_crucible,sieve-pattern}.kn, and all 36 docs-tsv lookup tables. THE_MESSIAH.KN (6,029-module amalgamation, ~795k lines) included as the expert reference.

Wrote AGENTS.md — onboarding + operating rules modeled on SetiYeti's: what TurboKain is, what Kain is (so it is not mistaken for a toy), the vendored baseline, CLI + stdlib pointers, data location, download permission, non-negotiable rules, pitfalls, and the Critical "analyze, do not just report CSVs" mandate.
Added .gitignore: .kain/, _tmp/, out/, *.exe, *.pdb, *.ll never committed.

Fast-binary install: copied the current built compiler to D:\tools\kain\kain.exe and D:\kain\.kain\bin\kain.exe so `kain` is the no-Bazel fast path everywhere; moved the Bazel dev shim to D:\tools\kain-dev\kain.exe behind `kaindev`. Set KAIN_BAZEL_LAUNCHER_DIR=D:\kain\.kain\devbin so dev syncs can never clobber the fast binary.

Stdlib-discovery bug fixed: module symbols (process/text/os/runtime_simd_*) silently vanished with "Unknown identifier" because no stdlib root was discoverable outside the D:\kain tree — builtins (fs_*, low-level runtime) still resolved, masking it. Fix: junction D:\kain\.kain\stdlib -> D:\kain\stdlib, copy runtime archive to D:\kain\.kain\lib\kain_runtime.lib (no-triple discovery path), and set KAIN_HOME / KAIN_STDLIB_PATH / KAIN_RUNTIME_LIB_PATH in User and Machine scope.
Made the .kain/bin wrappers self-contained: kain (sh) and kain.cmd now default KAIN_HOME / KAIN_STDLIB_PATH / KAIN_RUNTIME_LIB_PATH so `kain` works in a bare shell that inherited no environment.
slice.kn (TurboKain 01, GUPPI slicer at C parity) unblocked by the stdlib fix: `kain check` EXIT=0 and `kain build --target llvm` EXIT=0, slice.exe produced. Was blocked on exactly 4 module symbols.
Re-verified lane_sieve.kn end-to-end after the env fixes: BUILD_EXIT=0 and the receipt is identical (lanes 3 + 7 QUARANTINE, receipt PASS, custom-geometry), exit 0.

AGENTS.md: added build-output behavior (exe lands in cwd, intermediates in <source-dir>/.kain; -o takes a file not a dir; convention = build from the tool's folder), the stdlib+runtime discovery section, and the two-commands table (kain fast vs kaindev dev).
Established this memory.tsv ledger: every file change gets a row (date, area, type, description, file). Modeled on the Kain repo's memory.tsv discipline.

Established catalog.tsv — the TurboKain tool/artifact ledger (tool, source, exe, kind, status, prove, receipt, consumes, produces, notes, updated). Sky-data files stay catalogued in SetiYeti's catalog.tsv (single scientific record) and are referenced here by name.
AGENTS.md: added the Ledgers section (memory.tsv change-log rule + catalog.tsv tool-ledger rule) and listed both in the repo layout.
Added scripts/memlog.py helper (tab-safe append to memory.tsv) so agents log changes without formatting mistakes.
AGENTS.md: documented scripts/memlog.py usage in the Ledgers section and added scripts/ to the repo layout.

scripts/memlog.kn — pure-Kain replacement for the Python change-log helper: appends a memory.tsv row (ISO date from the system clock, tab/newline sanitize, header seed on new ledger). Built scripts/memlog.exe. Keeps the repo pure Kain + MarkScript.
Removed scripts/memlog.py — Python helper replaced by the Kain memlog. No non-Kain runtimes in this repo.
AGENTS.md: replaced the Python memlog instructions with the Kain build/run flow, and stated the repo rule — pure Kain + MarkScript, never add a helper in another language.
AGENTS.md: added the memlog CLI reference to the main CLI commands section (build once, run from repo root, stamps date/seeds header/sanitizes).
